title: ❄️ LIVE SNOW COVERAGE
noaa_source: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km snow analysis (SNOD snow depth + SNOWC snow cover), hourly cycles
product_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km snow analysis (SNOD snow depth + SNOWC snow cover), hourly cycles
variable: SNOD snow depth (m) gated by SNOWC snow cover (%), analysis step: COLOR = confirmed snow on the ground; hrrr.20260924 t03z
spatial_resolution_rendered: 1800x1175 canvas over lon [-93.0,-73.5], lat [40.5,49.5] (mean-value binning, no upsampling of source precision)
missing_data_treatment: only SNOD>0.002 m with SNOWC>0 inside Michigan admitted; no-snow/cloud/invalid/out-of-state transparent; never interpolated.
shoreline_mask: assets/great_lakes_watermask.png — shared NOAA medium-resolution shoreline water mask (nautical-chart compilation, mean-high-water datum; snapped + polygonized once, full vertex precision, antialiased). Overlay alpha is multiplied by this mask and edge RGB is bled into transparent pixels (anti-fringe for bilinear clients), so every product shares one shoreline.
attribution: Data: US NOAA. This project is not endorsed by NOAA. See DATA_SOURCES.md for exact products and endpoints.
legend_scale_html: Snow depth on the ground (in), continuous: LOWEST 0 (silver-gray) → HIGHEST+ 24 (white extreme). Shows snow currently on the ground. Falling snow, clouds, precipitation without confirmed ground snow, and uncertain observations are transparent.
